associated_data_options.label: 🔐 Device Identity
associated_data_options.description: Identifies which device generated or received the message.

associated_data_options.label: ⏱️ Timestamp
associated_data_options.description: Indicates when the message was created or sent.

associated_data_options.label: 📡 Network Route Info
associated_data_options.description: Describes how the message travels through the network.

associated_data_options.label: 🌐 Source Address
associated_data_options.description: Shows where the message originated from.

associated_data_options.label: 🎯 Destination Address
associated_data_options.description: Shows the intended recipient of the message.

associated_data_options.label: ⚙️ Control Command
associated_data_options.description: Specifies that the message carries a command or instruction.

associated_data_options.label: 📊 Sensor Data Context
associated_data_options.description: Indicates that the message contains sensor measurements.

associated_data_options.label: 🚨 System Alert
associated_data_options.description: Marks the message as a warning or alert.

associated_data_options.label: 🛡️ Authentication Context
associated_data_options.description: Used during authentication or verification processes.

associated_data_options.label: 🔄 Rekey / Update Event
associated_data_options.description: Indicates a security or key update operation.
